tv: TCL 43S5K / 32V5C (G13, G13_2K_GB, MediaTek MT9221/MT5867, 1 GB), India; also a G13 unit from Brazil, a 40" V5C on AU13 and a 32V51C from Indonesia (AU13)
notes: Both use the G13_2K_GB / UKN2.241110.001 / AU10 build; a Brazilian unit on AU07 applied the full 43S5K list, plus Claro TV+ and Mercado Play (commented, Brazil only); a 40" V5C on AU13 took the same packages plus MediaTek's MtkDemo, and its launcher handover works once setupwraith is off, as on AU10. 43S5K also disables partnercustomizer, Play Games and Assistant (katniss); the 32V5C test disabled the nine-package subset: TCL messagebox/logkit, partner auto-installs/attribution, TCL browser, Google feedback/consent, setupwraith and dreamx. TCL analytics/updater is one app (ttvs, kept for updates); Live TV/HDMI are MediaTek's `wwtv.tvcenter`, not `com.tcl.tv`; the 43S5K's saved Wi-Fi belongs to setupwraith, so re-join before disabling it, while the 32V5C network survived and the Brazilian unit's network in use belonged to the system (verify the owner); launcherx is disabled only after CleanYourTV owns Home; gear keycode 83 (`settings_key_keycodes`); a bound HomeKeyService can stop volume long-press repeat; the Indonesian 32V51C (AU13): disable.sh skips MtkDemo (TV_INPUT_HARDWARE) and gtvpai (unreadable) unless TVINPUT_ALLOW=1, TGuard and a store demo also shipped, and without the gear helper Settings via Home cost the running app on 1 GB
